artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: record(bronze_doc, extraction, backlog_row) builds one typed silver row per bronze research-report object (security_key, report_id, bronze_key, extract_key, fetched_at, file_ext, source_relpath, size_bytes, words_or_pages, report_class+class_evidence, fund+evidence/absent_reason, sector_as_written+evidence/absent_reason, period+period_source+evidence/absent_reason, author+evidence/absent_reason). classify_report() checks C (word-capped short form) then D (stock-move) then B (a RECOMMENDATION line carrying a numeric position size, or the earnings-update filename token) then A (research-pack/note filename token), else OTHER. resolve_period() runs ONE token-finder ladder (full date > month-name date > quarter > half-year > fiscal-year-only) at three stages (filename, header, content). --write measured on the real 123-object corpus: silver_rows 123 of 123 bronze; class A 16 B 31 C 3 D 1 OTHER 72; fund IDVZ 37 PFOE 7 DIVZ 0 absent 79; k5 period carried 103 of 123 by filename 95 header 7 content 1 absent 20; backlog files 351 = resolved_files 123 + unresolved_files 228 (60 unresolved-folder lines, reasons read verbatim from CRPS-c-4's stored backlog document).

14 offline tests under the poison: each class A-D decided from a minimal fixture, OTHER for a [PASTE EXCEL OUTPUT] blank template and for a non-extractable/workbook fixture; fund/sector/author/period each proven ABSENT-with-reason on a sparse fixture; reports_for() over a monkeypatched store.silver_latest returns three out-of-order periods ascending with an undated row last; period_order_ok() proven True (ascending) and False (deliberately unsorted) directly; a poison positive control.
